cses-weird-algorithm.input_format_md: The only input line contains an integer $n$.
cses-weird-algorithm.output_format_md: Print the sequence of values generated by the algorithm, separated by spaces, ending when the value becomes $1$.

cses-missing-number.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n-1$ distinct integers in the range $1\dots n$.

cses-repetitions.input_format_md: The only input line contains a DNA string of length $n$ consisting of characters `A`, `C`, `G`, and `T`.
cses-repetitions.output_format_md: Print one integer: the maximum repetition length.

cses-increasing-array.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_n$.
cses-increasing-array.output_format_md: Print the minimum number of moves.

cses-bit-strings.input_format_md: The only input line contains an integer $n$.
cses-bit-strings.output_format_md: Print the number of bit strings of length $n$, modulo $10^9+7$.

cses-distinct-numbers.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $x_1,x_2,\dots,x_n$.
cses-distinct-numbers.output_format_md: Print the number of distinct values.

cses-apartments.input_format_md:
The first line contains three integers $n$, $m$, and $k$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1,\dots,a_n$ (desired sizes).

The third line contains $m$ integers $b_1,\dots,b_m$ (apartment sizes).
cses-apartments.output_format_md: Print one integer: the maximum number of applicants who get an apartment.

cses-ferris-wheel.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $w_1,\dots,w_n$.
cses-ferris-wheel.output_format_md: Print the minimum number of gondolas.

cses-movie-festival.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

Then $n$ lines follow, each with two integers $a$ and $b$: the start and end time of a movie.
cses-movie-festival.output_format_md: Print the maximum number of movies you can watch entirely.

cses-restaurant-customers.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

Then $n$ lines follow, each with two integers $a$ and $b$: arrival and leaving times.
cses-restaurant-customers.output_format_md: Print the maximum number of customers present at the same time.

cses-dice-combinations.input_format_md: The only input line contains an integer $n$.
cses-dice-combinations.output_format_md: Print the number of ways to construct sum $n$, modulo $10^9+7$.

cses-minimizing-coins.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$: the number of coins and the target sum.

The second line contains $n$ distinct coin values $c_1,\dots,c_n$.
cses-minimizing-coins.output_format_md: Print the minimum number of coins, or $-1$ if it is impossible.

cses-coin-combinations-ii.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$.

The second line contains $n$ coin values $c_1,\dots,c_n$.
cses-coin-combinations-ii.output_format_md: Print the number of ordered combinations (by coin type) that sum to $x$, modulo $10^9+7$.

cses-book-shop.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$: the number of books and the maximum total price.

The second line contains $n$ integers $h_1,\dots,h_n$ (prices).

The third line contains $n$ integers $s_1,\dots,s_n$ (pages).
cses-book-shop.output_format_md: Print the maximum number of pages you can buy.

cses-removing-digits.input_format_md: The only input line contains an integer $n$.
cses-removing-digits.output_format_md: Print the minimum number of steps to reach $0$.

cses-grid-paths-dp.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

Then $n$ lines follow, each with $n$ characters: `.` is free and `*` is trapped.
cses-grid-paths-dp.output_format_md: Print the number of paths from the top-left to the bottom-right, modulo $10^9+7$.

cses-message-route.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$: the number of computers and connections.

Then $m$ lines follow, each with two integers $a$ and $b$: an undirected connection.
cses-message-route.output_format_md: If a route exists, print two lines: the number of computers on the shortest route, then the computers on one such route from $1$ to $n$. Otherwise print `IMPOSSIBLE`.

cses-labyrinth.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $n$ lines follow describing the map: `#` wall, `.` floor, `A` start, `B` end.
cses-labyrinth.output_format_md: If a path exists, print `YES`, then the length, then a string of moves using `U`,`D`,`L`,`R`. Otherwise print `NO`.

cses-round-trip.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $m$ lines follow, each with two integers $a$ and $b$: an undirected road.
cses-round-trip.output_format_md: If a cycle of length at least $3$ exists, print its length, then the cities on the cycle (starting and ending at the same city). Otherwise print `IMPOSSIBLE`.

cses-tree-diameter.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

Then $n-1$ lines follow describing the tree edges.
cses-tree-diameter.output_format_md: Print the diameter (maximum number of edges on any path).

cses-shortest-routes-ii.input_format_md:
The first line contains three integers $n$, $m$, and $q$.

Then $m$ lines follow with flight descriptions $a\ b\ c$ (from, to, length).

Then $q$ lines follow with queries $a\ b$.
cses-shortest-routes-ii.output_format_md: For each query print the shortest distance, or $-1$ if unreachable.

cses-high-score.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $m$ lines follow with tunnels $a\ b\ x$ (from, to, score).
cses-high-score.output_format_md: Print the maximum score when going from $1$ to $n$, or $-1$ if the score can be arbitrarily large.

cses-towers.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n$ integers: the cube sizes in processing order.
cses-towers.output_format_md: Print the minimum number of towers.

cses-string-matching.input_format_md:
The first line contains the string $s$.

The second line contains the pattern $p$.
cses-string-matching.output_format_md: Print the number of occurrences of $p$ in $s$.

cses-word-combinations.input_format_md:
The first line contains the string $s$.

The second line contains an integer $k$.

Then $k$ lines follow with the dictionary words.
cses-word-combinations.output_format_md: Print the number of ways to form $s$, modulo $10^9+7$.

cses-array-division.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $k$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $x_1,\dots,x_n$.
cses-array-division.output_format_md: Print the minimum possible maximum subarray sum.

cses-tasks-and-deadlines.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

Then $n$ lines follow, each with two integers $a_i$ and $d_i$: duration and deadline.

cses-subarray-sums-i.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$.

The second line contains $n$ positive integers $a_1,\dots,a_n$.
cses-subarray-sums-i.output_format_md: Print the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals $x$.

cses-subarray-sums-ii.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1,\dots,a_n$ (may be negative).
cses-subarray-sums-ii.output_format_md: Print the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals $x$.

cses-company-queries-i.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $q$.

The second line contains $n-1$ integers: the boss of each employee $2\dots n$.

Then $q$ lines follow with queries $x\ k$.
cses-company-queries-i.output_format_md: For each query print the $k$-th boss of $x$, or $-1$ if none.

cses-distance-queries.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $q$.

Then $n-1$ lines follow with tree edges.

Then $q$ lines follow with queries $a\ b$.
cses-distance-queries.output_format_md: For each query print the distance between $a$ and $b$.

cses-range-sum-queries-i.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $q$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1,\dots,a_n$.

Then $q$ lines follow with queries $a\ b$ (1-indexed inclusive range).
cses-range-sum-queries-i.output_format_md: For each query print the sum of values in range $[a,b]$.

cses-range-update-queries.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $q$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1,\dots,a_n$.

Then $q$ lines follow. Type `1 a b u` adds $u$ to range $[a,b]$. Type `2 k` asks for the value at position $k$.
cses-range-update-queries.output_format_md: For each type-$2$ query print the value at position $k$.

cses-sum-of-two-values.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1,\dots,a_n$.
cses-sum-of-two-values.output_format_md: Print any two positions whose values sum to $x$, or `IMPOSSIBLE`.

cses-maximum-subarray-sum.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1,\dots,a_n$.

cses-stick-lengths.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $p_1,\dots,p_n$.
cses-stick-lengths.output_format_md: Print the minimum total cost to make all sticks equal.

cses-collecting-numbers.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains a permutation of $1\dots n$.
cses-collecting-numbers.output_format_md: Print the number of rounds needed to collect the numbers in order.

cses-playlist.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n$ integers: the song ids.
cses-playlist.output_format_md: Print the maximum length of a contiguous segment with distinct songs.

cses-counting-rooms.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $n$ lines follow with the map (`#` wall, `.` floor).

cses-building-teams.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $m$ lines follow with friendships.
cses-building-teams.output_format_md: Print a valid team assignment of $n$ integers (`1` or `2`), or `IMPOSSIBLE`.

cses-shortest-routes-i.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $m$ lines follow with directed flights $a\ b\ c$.
cses-shortest-routes-i.output_format_md: Print $n$ integers: distances from city $1$ to cities $1\dots n$.

cses-flight-discount.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $m$ lines follow with flights $a\ b\ c$.
cses-flight-discount.output_format_md: Print the minimum price from $1$ to $n$ when you may halve the cost of at most one flight.

cses-coin-combinations-i.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $x$.

The second line contains $n$ coin values.
cses-coin-combinations-i.output_format_md: Print the number of ordered ways to form sum $x$, modulo $10^9+7$.

cses-edit-distance.input_format_md:
The first line contains string $s$.

The second line contains string $t$.
cses-edit-distance.output_format_md: Print the edit distance between $s$ and $t$.

cses-course-schedule.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $m$ lines follow with requirements $a\ b$ ($a$ before $b$).
cses-course-schedule.output_format_md: Print a valid course order, or `IMPOSSIBLE`.

cses-road-construction.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

Then $m$ lines follow with roads added one by one.
cses-road-construction.output_format_md: After each road print two integers: the number of components and the size of the largest component.

cses-subordinates.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n-1$ integers: the boss of each employee $2\dots n$.
cses-subordinates.output_format_md: Print $n$ integers: for each employee, the number of subordinates.

cses-factory-machines.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $t$.

The second line contains $n$ integers: machine times.
cses-factory-machines.output_format_md: Print the minimum time to produce $t$ products.

cses-nested-ranges-check.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

Then $n$ lines follow with ranges $x\ y$.
cses-nested-ranges-check.output_format_md: Print two lines of $n$ bits each: whether each range contains another, and whether each is contained in another.

cf-4a.input_format_md: The only input line contains an integer $w$ ($1 \le w \le 100$).
cf-4a.output_format_md: Print `YES` if the watermelon can be divided into two positive even parts, otherwise `NO`.

cf-1a.input_format_md: The only input line contains three integers $n$, $m$, and $a$.
cf-1a.output_format_md: Print the minimum number of flagstones needed.

cf-706b.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $n$.

The second line contains $n$ integers: shop prices.

The third line contains an integer $q$.

Then $q$ lines follow with Vasiliy's money on each day.
cf-706b.output_format_md: For each day print how many shops he can afford.

cf-1360c.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $t$ (test cases).

Each test case: an integer $n$, then a line with $n$ integers.
cf-1360c.output_format_md: For each test case print `YES` or `NO`.

cf-489b.input_format_md:
The first line contains $n$, then a line with $n$ boy skills.

Then $m$, then a line with $m$ girl skills.
cf-489b.output_format_md: Print the maximum number of pairs.

cf-550a.input_format_md: The only input line contains a string $s$ consisting of uppercase letters.
cf-550a.output_format_md: Print `YES` if $s$ contains non-overlapping `AB` and `BA` as substrings (in either order), otherwise `NO`.

cf-580c.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $0/1$ (cats).

Then $n-1$ edges of the tree follow.
cf-580c.output_format_md: Print the number of restaurants (leaves) reachable without more than $m$ consecutive cats.

cf-279b.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $t$.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_i$ (minutes per book).
cf-279b.output_format_md: Print the maximum number of books in a contiguous segment readable in at most $t$ minutes.

cf-1201d.input_format_md:
The first line contains four integers $n$, $m$, $k$, $q$.

Then $k$ lines with treasure coordinates.

Then $q$ integers: the safe columns.
cf-1201d.output_format_md: Print the minimum number of moves to collect all treasures.

atc-dp-frog1.input_format_md:
The first line contains an integer $N$.

The second line contains $N$ integers $h_1,\dots,h_N$.
atc-dp-frog1.output_format_md: Print the minimum total cost to reach stone $N$.

atc-dp-frog2.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $N$ and $K$.

The second line contains $N$ integers $h_1,\dots,h_N$.
atc-dp-frog2.output_format_md: Print the minimum total cost to reach stone $N$.

atc-dp-knapsack1.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $N$ and $W$.

Then $N$ lines follow with $w_i$ and $v_i$.
atc-dp-knapsack1.output_format_md: Print the maximum total value with weight at most $W$.

usaco-fence-painting.input_format_md:
The first line contains two integers $a$ and $b$.

The second line contains two integers $c$ and $d$.
usaco-fence-painting.output_format_md: Print the number of units of fence painted at least once.

uva-how-many-trees.input_format_md: Input consists of several integers $n$ ($1 \le n \le 300$), one per line. A line with $0$ ends the input and is not processed.
uva-how-many-trees.output_format_md: For each $n$ print the number of labeled binary trees on $n$ nodes, followed by a newline.

demo-euclidiana.input_format_md: Each test case is a line with two integers $A$ and $B$ (cell ids). Input ends with a line containing $-1\ -1$.
demo-euclidiana.output_format_md: For each test case print the Euclidean distance between the cell centers (typically with fixed precision).

demo-maja.input_format_md: Input contains one or more integers (Willi's honeycomb numbers), each on its own line.
demo-maja.output_format_md: For each number print the corresponding Maja coordinates $x\ y$ on its own line.
